verdict.rationale: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure offers AI services such as OCI Generative AI and Select AI, so a training-data opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any policy, setting, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The release notes on model import and Select AI only show that AI features exist; they say nothing about how customer data is used.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
